captions: 5:10 a.m. Your bakery. Rent is due on Monday.
The dough. The oven. The app again: €312.
You knead harder. As if it could change the number.
Uncle Hamid slides the bread in. He hums. He never checks.
Then, through the window: the adhan for Fajr.
He wipes the flour off his hands. “Coming? The bread can wait.”
Two rows. Flour still on your sleeves.
Your forehead on the floor: “Ya Allah, You know about the rent.”
You walk back lighter. The first customer is already at the door.

post.caption:
9 times you checked your bank app. 0 times you asked Allah. 🤍

5:10 a.m. in your bakery. Rent is due Monday. The app again: €312. Uncle Hamid slides the bread in and hums — he never checks. Then the adhan for Fajr: “Coming? The bread can wait.”

“And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him.” (65:3)

This morning: two rak’ahs of Duha. Before you check your balance.
